final_assessment: Archived rc17a-invoked-coverage to orbit/changes/archive/2026-10-06-rc17a-invoked-coverage/: spec-driven version 5, both reviewed gates [invoked, in-context]; review-system passed by computation through the first launched blind pair.
warnings: Pre-archive audit (in flow, no separate emit), category 5 Touchpoints divergence — 3 WARNING (substantive sources the frozen Touchpoints did not predict, though tasks 3.6 and 4.2 named them): src/core/artifact-graph/instruction-loader.ts, src/core/templates/workflows/apply-change.ts, src/core/templates/workflows/review.ts; 7 SUGGESTION (docs/tests riding along): CLAUDE.md, orbit/architecture/clean-up-review-cycle.md, orbit/config.yaml, orbit/scenario-ledger.yaml, both moved report goldens, test/helpers/invoked-oracle.ts. Categories 1, 3, 4 and 6 clean; category 2 skipped (orbit/lenses/ absent).

The full suite's wall time rose from about 25 s to about 77 s: the exhaustive oracle (21,007,908 cases, six shards, slowest shard about 48 s) is now its long pole. Measured at apply and at the system walk, not by a review pass.
Fingerprints 8/8 verified; sync 3 ADDED + 8 MODIFIED, 11/11 delta blocks byte-verified in baseline through the engine's applySpecs.

judgements.reasoning: Both reviewed gates computed PASSED, the system gate through the first real launched blind pair (a pair: true T0, then a fresh and an external half, blind), which covered the invoked slot exactly as the change specifies. The pair's seven findings — one CRITICAL crash, three WARNINGs in the new mechanism — were all reproduced and repaired, the exhaustive oracle was widened to the two blind spots both halves named (reason text, launch-boundary ties) and shown able to fail on each, and the in-context verification's one regression was repaired as three pointers. What remains is stated below.

accepted.claim: PASSED means every finding resolved, not that an independent pass stood clean on the final tree: system walk 3's edits (three spec pointers, two goal qualifications, D10, a closure note) were read by no pass, because a walk of the in-context pass raises no slot's bar.
accepted.why: Prose only, no code; the sweep gate verified every introduced and retired string, and the edits point at a table the oracle grades. Another pass would buy a read of five sentences.

accepted.claim: The proposal phase's walk 3 repairs were likewise read by no review pass; apply's first read of D9, D4 and tasks 5.1/6.1 stood in as the check.
accepted.why: Recorded at propose; the system pair then reviewed the implemented mechanism those repairs specify.

accepted.claim: The oracle's stated size bounds its proof: trails of up to five events in one mode, passes without findings (so clause (b) never interacts with membership in it), and only an EXTERNAL return as the launch-tie event; the fresh launch tie is a unit test.
accepted.why: A fresh pass cannot share a T0's token through the shipped emit surface (the collision bump clears every trail token); larger trails are covered by the hand-written scenario suites, not exhaustively.

accepted.claim: Order-based membership counts a single invoked while a pair launch stands open as that pair's member (D-bpc-10's named limit, widened to both classes by D4).
accepted.why: Stated once in orbit-engine-gates with its residual method; no emit records how a pass was invoked until rc17b's command does.

accepted.claim: orbit-run-summary-emit's scenario sentence qualified 'under spec-driven v4' still describes v4.
accepted.why: A version-qualified sentence that stays true of v4, and its THEN holds under v5; a fourth capability declined under R-crc-1 (design, Risks).
